segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through the final quote for the analytics workspace, 42 seats, with the implementation package starting May 6.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that lines up. The main thing I wanted to confirm is the invoice timing. Our finance team needs the first invoice dated after April 15, not before.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. We can set the contract start date to May 1 and have the first invoice generate on April 16 for the annual amount, $38,640, net 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And that includes the admin training and the two data connector sessions, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. The package includes one 90-minute admin training, two 60-minute connector sessions, and a go-live check-in during the week of May 27.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. We may add eight more seats in Q3 if the operations group comes on. Is that just prorated?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Exactly. Any added seats would be prorated through April 30 next year at the same per-seat rate, so no new tier or anything like that.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds straightforward. Send the order form to me and copy Ben in procurement. If the terms match what we discussed, we should be able to sign by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it over this afternoon with the May 1 start date, April 16 invoice date, 42 seats, and the implementation package listed separately.
